a: अपौरुष --पौरुषेय — a. 1 Unmanly, cowardly, timid. --2 Superhuman, not of the authorship of man, of divine origin; अपोरुषेया वेदाः; अपौरुषेयप्रतिष्ठः सुवर्णबिंदुरित्याख्यायते Māl. 9. not set up by (the hand of) man. --षं, --षेयं 1 Cowardice, pussilanimity. --2 Superhuman power.

m: अ-पौरुषेय mfn. not coming from men, ṢaḍvBr.
